acceptance: With the direct-only flag, every returned train has zero transfers.
Without the flag, search output is the same as before.
The result limit is applied after filtering, so up to the limit of direct trains is returned.
The flag is listed in the CLI help text and the README usage section.

data.message:
Add --direct to renfe search to keep only trains with no change

Filtering runs before --limit, so the limit counts direct trains only. The flag is in the CLI help and the README.
Tests: two new CLI tests in tests/test_cli.py (direct filter with limit; flag in help). Both failed on the base before the change. A flipped filter condition makes the direct test fail. Full suite: 695 passed, 15 skipped, 1 failed (tests/test_legacy.py::test_cli_search_falls_back_with_exit_0, which uses the fixed date 2026-11-20 and is rejected as in the past; not touched by this change).
